mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contest_subscription (user_id, contest_id, remind_before_minutes, channel, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contestId}, #{remindBeforeMinutes}, #{channel}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE contest_subscription SET status = 1, channel = #{channel}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE contest_subscription SET status = 0, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.contest_id AS contestId, c.title AS contestTitle, c.source AS source, c.start_time AS contestStartTime, s.remind_before_minutes AS remindBeforeMinutes, s.channel, s.status, s.created_time AS createdTime FROM contest_subscription s INNER JOIN contest c ON c.id = s.contest_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY c.start_time ASC
